records.name: Bringer of Balance
records.summary: A unique weapon taken from an altar in an underground ruin west of Tashelp; nothing in the game points at it.

acquisitions.note: One-time pickup from an altar; can be returned to at any time.

steps.text: Ride to the area south of the Forbearers Barons map label, west of Tashelp.
steps.missableNote: No in-game marker; easy to gallop past.

steps.text: Find the trap door and drop into the ruin below.
Follow the passage to the altar and take the weapon.

records.name: Blackwing Mask
records.summary: Head piece of the Blackwing set, dropped by the Crowcaller; the rest of the set is scattered as exploration loot.

acquisitions.note: Drops from the Crowcaller together with one Blackwing armour piece; the remaining pieces are exploration loot elsewhere.

records.name: Canta Plate
records.summary: Starter plate armour sold by Rhett in Hernand; a plain silver purchase with no prerequisites beyond reaching the city.

acquisitions.note: Price not yet recorded.

records.name: Circling Moon
records.summary: A unique weapon taken when the Full Moon Reaper falls during Lunar Judgement.

acquisitions.note: Drops from the Full Moon Reaper on the Lunar Judgement quest; that quest has no record here yet.

steps.text: Take up Lunar Judgement when that quest opens.
Defeat the Full Moon Reaper.
Take Circling Moon from the fall.

records.name: Crow Whisperer
records.summary: A unique weapon taken from Hexe Marie and also listed among the Veiled Witch rewards.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Hexe Marie at the end of the Veiled Witch stretch.

steps.text: Follow Veiled Witch until the Black Witch is in reach.
Defeat Hexe Marie.
Take Crow Whisperer from the fall.

acquisitions.note: The Veiled Witch reward list also names Crow Whisperer.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Frostfang
records.summary: A unique weapon taken from Gwen Kraber at Roothold in Hernand.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Gwen Kraber at Roothold; that site has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Ride to Roothold in Hernand.
Defeat Gwen Kraber.
Take Frostfang from the fall.

records.name: Golden Vanguard
records.summary: A two-handed weapon taken from Gregor, the Halberd of Carnage, during the Chapter 8 stretch.
records.body: The unique-weapons list ties this to Gregor in Ashen Steps. The chapter table also files it under A Fleeting Dream. The Chapter 8 walkthrough pays it on [[quest:where-the-wind-guides-you]]. Like other gear, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Gregor, the Halberd of Carnage, on the Ashen Steps stretch.

steps.text: Take up the Ashen Steps work in Chapter 8.
Defeat Gregor, the Halberd of Carnage.
Take Golden Vanguard from the fall.

acquisitions.note: The Chapter 8 walkthrough also lists it among the rewards of Where the Wind Guides You.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Grasping Moon
records.summary: A unique weapon taken when the Half Moon Reaper falls during Lunar Judgement.

acquisitions.note: Drops from the Half Moon Reaper on the Lunar Judgement quest; that quest has no record here yet.

steps.text: Take up Lunar Judgement when that quest opens.
Defeat the Half Moon Reaper.
Take Grasping Moon from the fall.

records.name: Sanguine Knell
records.summary: A unique weapon taken from Mazzul during One Step Ahead.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Mazzul on One Step Ahead; that quest has no record here yet.

steps.text: Take up One Step Ahead when that quest opens.
Defeat Mazzul.
Take Sanguine Knell from the fall.

records.name: Sword of the Lord
records.summary: A one-handed sword taken from Hornsplitter at the close of The End of Greed.
records.body: One unique-weapons page says Hornsplitter drops this at the end of [[quest:the-end-of-greed]]. A separate best-weapons page calls it a starting weapon that comes with Abyss Gear. The Chapter 2 reward list names it on [[quest:cheers-echoing-from-the-edge]]. Like other gear, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Hornsplitter when The End of Greed closes.

steps.text: Push The End of Greed through to the Hornsplitter fight.
Defeat Kailok the Hornsplitter.
Take Sword of the Lord when the chapter rewards are paid.

acquisitions.note: The Chapter 2 reward list also names it on Cheers Echoing From the Edge.

records.name: Black Sun
records.summary: A shield found in a chest beneath the bridge at Demeniss Castle.

acquisitions.note: The chest sits under the castle bridge.

steps.text: Ride to Demeniss Castle and drop under the bridge that fronts it.
Open the chest beneath the span and take the shield.

records.name: Blazing Shield
records.summary: A shield hidden in an unmarked cave somewhere in the Crimson Desert.

acquisitions.note: The cave is unmarked and has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Search the Crimson Desert for an unmarked cave.
Open the chest inside and take the shield.

records.name: Crimson Warden's Bow
records.summary: A bow taken from a treasure chest on the Golden Plains in Demeniss.

acquisitions.note: The chest sits on the Golden Plains; that field has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Ride out onto the Golden Plains in Demeniss.
Find the treasure chest and take the bow.

records.name: Darkbringer
records.summary: A two-handed weapon found in the White Wastes Sanctuary in Pailune.
records.body: A best-weapons page also calls this an early exploration pickup. Like other gear, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: The chest is in the White Wastes Sanctuary; that site has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Ride into Pailune and find the White Wastes Sanctuary.
Open the chest inside and take Darkbringer.

records.name: Demenissian Hero's Musket
records.summary: A musket found in a chest inside Lost Song Cave.

acquisitions.note: The chest is in Lost Song Cave; that cave has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Find Lost Song Cave and go inside.
Open the chest and take the musket.

records.name: Diverging Moon
records.summary: A unique weapon in a chest at the Southern Court, reachable only after that court is liberated.

acquisitions.note: The chest is at the Southern Court after liberation; that site has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Liberate the Southern Court.
Enter the court once it is free.
Open the chest and take Diverging Moon.

records.name: Drake Shield
records.summary: A shield claimed after Tristan the Flame Knight falls and Flame Knight Castle is freed.
records.body: The unique-weapons and best-shields pages both send you through the Flame Knight faction work, then up the stairs past two Demenissian Soldiers to a chest. Like other gear, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: Tied to defeating Tristan the Flame Knight and freeing Flame Knight Castle; neither has a record here yet.

steps.text: Take the Flame Knight faction work that leads to Flame Knight Castle.
Defeat Tristan the Flame Knight and free the castle.

acquisitions.note: After the castle is free, the chest is up the stairs past two Demenissian Soldiers.

steps.text: Climb the stairs inside the freed castle.
Pass the two Demenissian Soldiers on the way up.
Open the chest and take the shield.

records.name: Electro-Mecha Spear
records.summary: A two-handed spear found in a chest at Regent's Rise.

acquisitions.note: The chest is at Regent's Rise; that site has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Travel to Regent's Rise.
Open the chest and take the spear.

records.name: Elite Vanguard
records.summary: A unique weapon found in a cave on Bowsprit Cape.

acquisitions.note: The chest is in a cave on Bowsprit Cape; that cape has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Ride to Bowsprit Cape and find the cave.
Open the chest inside and take Elite Vanguard.

records.name: Frozen Anguish
records.summary: A unique weapon found in a chest at the Spire of Frost.

acquisitions.note: The chest is at the Spire of Frost; that spire has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Travel to the Spire of Frost.
Open the chest and take Frozen Anguish.

records.name: Fated Shadow
records.summary: A unique weapon taken from Goyen during Chapter 9.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Goyen in Chapter 9; no source names a single quest for that fight.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 9, The Sage of the Desert.
Defeat Goyen and take Fated Shadow.

records.name: Golden Shield
records.summary: A shield found in a chest inside Silentwater Grotto.

acquisitions.note: The chest is in Silentwater Grotto; that grotto has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Find Silentwater Grotto and go inside.
Open the chest and take the shield.

records.name: Goblin King's Treasure Dagger
records.summary: A dagger found in a chest beneath Mudridge Cabin.

acquisitions.note: The chest sits under Mudridge Cabin; that cabin has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Find Mudridge Cabin and look beneath it.
Open the chest and take the dagger.

records.name: Hwando
records.summary: A two-handed sword found in a chest at Lioncrest Manor.

acquisitions.note: The chest is at Lioncrest Manor, which is not the same site as Lioncrest Watchtower.

steps.text: Travel to Lioncrest Manor.
Open the chest and take Hwando.

records.name: Knightlord's Sword
records.summary: A one-handed sword in a chest at Crescent Lake during the Dark Justiciar quest.

acquisitions.note: The chest is at Crescent Lake on Dark Justiciar; neither that lake nor that quest has a record here yet.

steps.text: Take up the Dark Justiciar quest.
Travel to Crescent Lake.
Open the chest and take Knightlord's Sword.

records.name: Shield of Conviction
records.summary: A shield in the bell tower of the Church of Calphade, on Hernand's Calphade march.

acquisitions.note: The chest is in the church bell tower; the Church of Calphade has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Travel to the Church of Calphade.
Climb the bell tower.
Open the chest and take the shield.

records.name: Shield of Sacrifice
records.summary: A shield found in a cave in the Thornbriar Mountains.

acquisitions.note: The chest is in a Thornbriar Mountains cave; that cave has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Ride into the Thornbriar Mountains and find the cave.
Open the chest inside and take the shield.

records.name: Sigremon Greataxe
records.summary: A greataxe found in a chest on Silver Wolf Mountain in Pailune.

acquisitions.note: The chest is on Silver Wolf Mountain.

steps.text: Climb Silver Wolf Mountain in Pailune.
Find the chest and take the greataxe.

records.name: Soul Spear
records.summary: A two-handed spear found in a chest at the Antumbra Ritual Grounds.

acquisitions.note: The chest is at the Antumbra Ritual Grounds; that site has no place record here yet.

steps.text: Travel to the Antumbra Ritual Grounds.
Open the chest and take Soul Spear.

records.name: Axe of the Apocalypse
records.summary: A one-use two-handed axe with immense attack, given for finishing the main story.
records.body: Awarded for finishing the main story. Sources give it a single use and an attack value of 99999. Like other gear it can be refined, but the one-use line is the fact the guides stress.

acquisitions.note: Given once the main story is finished; no single quest name is attached.

steps.text: Fight through to the last main-story bosses.
Collect the axe with the closing rewards.

records.name: Ignir
records.summary: A two-handed spear awarded at the close of Chapter 7.
records.body: The unique-weapons list and the Chapter 7 table both place this on the Homecoming close. The chapter table names it as a spear. Like other gear, it has ten material-only refinement ranks.

acquisitions.note: Paid at the close of Chapter 7, on Time to Face Justice.

steps.text: Finish the Homecoming fights through Ludvig.
Collect Ignir with the chapter rewards.

records.name: Melted Ambition
records.summary: A one-handed sword taken from Myurdin during the Decisive Battle stretch.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Myurdin on the Decisive Battle stretch; the chapter table records the pickup after that fight.

steps.text: Open the Decisive Battle stretch and climb toward Myurdin.
Defeat Myurdin on Silverwolf Mountain.
Take Melted Ambition after the fight.

records.name: Balgran Shield
records.summary: A shield included with the Deluxe Edition purchase.

acquisitions.note: Comes with the Deluxe Edition; no in-world pickup is named.

records.name: Khaled Shield
records.summary: A shield given as a pre-order bonus.

acquisitions.note: A pre-order bonus; no in-world pickup is named.

records.name: Grey Wolf Bow
records.summary: Kliff's starting bow, already in his kit when he first takes the field.

acquisitions.note: Unlocked by default for Kliff; no world pickup is named.

records.name: Grey Wolf Wooden Shield
records.summary: Kliff's starting shield, already equipped when the game begins.

acquisitions.note: Unlocked by default for Kliff as his starting shield.

records.name: Orc Blaster
records.summary: Oongka's starting hand cannon, already in his kit when he becomes playable.

acquisitions.note: Unlocked by default for Oongka as his starting hand cannon.

records.name: Silverwolf Axe
records.summary: A one-handed axe taken from Myurdin in the Decisive Battle stretch and treated as Kliff's key item.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Myurdin on the Decisive Battle stretch and is called Kliff's key item.

steps.text: Open the Decisive Battle stretch and climb toward Myurdin.
Defeat Myurdin on Silverwolf Mountain.
Take the Silverwolf Axe from the fall.

records.name: Sword of the Wolf
records.summary: Kliff's starting one-handed sword, already in his kit at the opening of the story.

acquisitions.note: Unlocked by default for Kliff as his starting sword.

records.name: Caliburn's Mercy Pistol
records.summary: Damiane's pistol, left on a table inside Fort Musket.

acquisitions.note: Picked up from a table inside Fort Musket.

steps.text: Enter Fort Musket.
Find the table and take the pistol.

records.name: Delesyian Ornamental Shield
records.summary: A shield taken from Storm Crusher during Brave New World in Delesyia.
records.body: Fextralife's weapon index lists a Delesyian Dagger as a separate item. This record is the ornamental shield from Storm Crusher, not that dagger.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Storm Crusher on Brave New World.

steps.text: Push the Brave New World stretch into Delesyia.
Fight Storm Crusher when that guardian appears on the fortress-key run.
Take the ornamental shield from the fall.

records.name: Golden Fire
records.summary: A hand cannon taken from Golden Star during Foreboding Shadow, and also listed among that chapter's unlocks.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Golden Star on the Foreboding Shadow stretch.

steps.text: Follow Foreboding Shadow until Golden Star is named.
Defeat Golden Star.
Take Golden Fire from the fall.

acquisitions.note: Also named in the Chapter 11 unlock bundle beside the Golden Star Power Core.

records.name: Guidance of Dark Pursuit
records.summary: A unique weapon taken after Antumbra's Staff falls.

acquisitions.note: Drops from the fight named Antumbra's Staff; that enemy has no record here yet.

steps.text: Find the fight named Antumbra's Staff.
Win that fight and take the weapon.

records.name: Leofric Musket
records.summary: A musket awarded for finishing Greater Firepower.
records.body: The unique-weapons list names Greater Firepower. The Chapter 10 table writes the same musket on the chapter-total rewards of [[quest:lingering-shadow]].

acquisitions.note: Awarded for completing Greater Firepower; the chapter total is written on Lingering Shadow.

steps.text: Work through the Greater Firepower stretch.
Collect the musket when the counterattack closes.

records.name: Marni Musket
records.summary: A musket taken from Storm Crusher during Brave New World.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Storm Crusher on Brave New World.

steps.text: Push the Brave New World stretch into Delesyia.
Fight Storm Crusher when that guardian appears on the fortress-key run.
Take the musket from the fall.

records.name: Mechanical Clockwork Blaster
records.summary: A hand cannon taken from Thunder Tank during Brave New World.

acquisitions.note: Drops from Thunder Tank on Brave New World.

steps.text: Push the Brave New World stretch into Delesyia.
Fight Thunder Tank when that guardian appears on the fortress-key run.
Take the blaster from the fall.
